name: No Stress Solving 2017
information: The registration fee is $10. There is a 60 person competitor limit. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Improper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the competitors tab within 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, and many unofficial events on the events tab.
